    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
),
target_quarter AS (
    SELECT toStartOfQuarter(

GROUP BY dd.CalendarQuarterLabel

    SELECT toYear(max(DateKey)) AS yr
    FROM retail.FactSales
)
SELECT
    if(pc.ProductCategoryName IS NULL OR pc.ProductCategoryName = '', toString(pc.ProductCategoryKey), pc.ProductCategoryName) AS `产品品类`,
    sum(f.SalesAmount - f.ReturnAmount) AS `净销售额`
FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = (SELECT yr FROM latest_year)
GROUP BY
    pc.ProductCategoryKey,
    pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY `净销售额` DESC
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1;
turns.assumption: 把“今年”理解为 retail.FactSales 中最新销售年份，净销售额按 SalesAmount − ReturnAmount 计算。

WITH order_sales AS (
    SELECT
        SalesOrderNumber,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS order_sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
),
annual AS (
    SELECT sum(SalesAmount) AS annual_sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
)
SELECT
    countIf(o.order_sales_amount > 1000) AS `订单笔数`,
    sumIf(o.order_sales_amount, o.order_sales_amount > 1000) AS `达标订单销售额`,
    max(a.annual_sales_amount) AS `全年销售额`,
    round(
        sumIf(o.order_sales_amount, o.order_sales_amount > 1000)
        / nullIf(max(a.annual_sales_amount), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS `占全年销售额百分比`
FROM order_sales o
CROSS JOIN annual a

WITH online_sales_usd AS (
    SELECT
        f.SalesOrderNumber,
        f.DateKey,
        f.SalesAmount / nullIf(r.AverageRate, 0) AS sales_amount_usd
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate AS r
        ON f.CurrencyKey = r.CurrencyKey
       AND f.DateKey = r.DateKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
),
order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        SalesOrderNumber,
        sum(sales_amount_usd) AS order_sales_amount_usd
    FROM online_sales_usd
    GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        countIf(order_sales_amount_usd > 1000) AS orders_over_1000_usd,
        sumIf(order_sales_amount_usd, order_sales_amount_usd > 1000) AS qualifying_sales_amount_usd,
        sum(order_sales_amount_usd) AS year_sales_amount_usd
    FROM order_totals
)
SELECT
    orders_over_1000_usd,
    qualifying_sales_amount_usd,
    year_sales_amount_usd,
    round(100.0 * qualifying_sales_amount_usd / nullIf(year_sales_amount_usd, 0), 2) AS pct_of_year_sales
FROM agg
turns.assumption: 「单笔金额」指同一 SalesOrderNumber 的订单合计金额，且 FactExchangeRate.AverageRate 表示 1 美元可兑换的外币数量，因此用 SalesAmount / AverageRate 折算为美元。

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2008) AS revenue_2008,
        sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2009) AS revenue_2009,
        sumIf(fs.SalesAmount - fs.TotalCost, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2008) AS gross_profit_2008,
        sumIf(fs.SalesAmount - fs.TotalCost, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2009) AS gross_profit_2009
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = toFloat64(ps.ProductSubcategoryKey)
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(fs.DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName AS `产品品类`,
    revenue_2008 AS `2008年营收`,
    revenue_2009 AS `2009年营收`,
    revenue_2009 - revenue_2008 AS `营收变化额`,
    round((revenue_2009 - revenue_2008) / nullIf(revenue_2008, 0) * 100, 2) AS `营收变化率%`,
    gross_profit_2008 AS `2008年毛利`,
    gross_profit_2009 AS `2009年毛利`,
    gross_profit_2009 - gross_profit_2008 AS `毛利变化额`,
    round((gross_profit_2009 - gross_profit_2008) / nullIf(gross_profit_2008, 0) * 100, 2) AS `毛利变化率%`
FROM category_year
WHERE revenue_2009 > revenue_2008
  AND gross_profit_2009 < gross_profit_2008
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName;
turns.assumption: 使用 retail.FactSales 汇总全渠道销售，营收取 SalesAmount，毛利取 SalesAmount − TotalCost，且未单独扣减退货和折扣。

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryKey AS category_key,
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS category_name,
        d.CalendarYear AS year,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue,
        sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS gross_profit
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f

    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p

        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName, d.CalendarYear

compared AS (
    SELECT
        y08.category_key,
        y08.category_name,
        y08.revenue AS revenue_2008,
        y09.revenue AS revenue_2009,
        y08.gross_profit AS gross_profit_2008,
        y09.gross_profit AS gross_profit_2009
    FROM yearly AS y08

        ON y08.category_key = y09.category_key
       AND y08.year = 2008
       AND y09.year = 2009

    category_name AS `品类`,
    round(revenue_2009 - revenue_2008, 2) AS `营收变化`,
    round((revenue_2009 - revenue_2008) / nullIf(revenue_2008, 0) * 100, 2) AS `营收变化率(%)`,

    round((gross_profit_2009 - gross_profit_2008) / nullIf(gross_profit_2008, 0) * 100, 2) AS `毛利变化率(%)`

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryKey AS ProductCategoryKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
        toYear(f.DateKey) AS SalesYear,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS Revenue,
        sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS GrossProfit
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = toFloat64(ps.ProductSubcategoryKey)
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        toYear(f.DateKey)
),
category_compare AS (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        sumIf(Revenue, SalesYear = 2008) AS Revenue2008,
        sumIf(Revenue, SalesYear = 2009) AS Revenue2009,
        sumIf(GrossProfit, SalesYear = 2008) AS GrossProfit2008,
        sumIf(GrossProfit, SalesYear = 2009) AS GrossProfit2009,
        countIf(SalesYear = 2008) AS Year2008Count,
        countIf(SalesYear = 2009) AS Year2009Count
    FROM category_year
    GROUP BY ProductCategoryKey, ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    Revenue2008,
    Revenue2009,
    Revenue2009 - Revenue2008 AS RevenueChange,
    round((Revenue2009 - Revenue2008) / nullIf(Revenue2008, 0) * 100, 2) AS RevenueChangePct,
    GrossProfit2008,
    GrossProfit2009,
    GrossProfit2009 - GrossProfit2008 AS GrossProfitChange,
    round((GrossProfit2009 - GrossProfit2008) / nullIf(GrossProfit2008, 0) * 100, 2) AS GrossProfitChangePct
FROM category_compare
WHERE Year2008Count > 0
  AND Year2009Count > 0
  AND Revenue2009 > Revenue2008
  AND GrossProfit2009 < GrossProfit2008

WITH
current_year AS (
    SELECT
        max(d.CalendarYear) AS y,
        max(d.DateKey) AS max_date
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
),
date_days AS (
    SELECT
        d.CalendarYear AS year,
        toQuarter(d.DateKey) AS quarter_num,
        any(d.CalendarQuarterLabel) AS quarter_label,
        count(DISTINCT d.DateKey) AS days_in_quarter
    FROM retail.DimDate AS d
    CROSS JOIN current_year AS cy
    WHERE (d.CalendarYear = cy.y OR d.CalendarYear = cy.y - 1)
      AND (d.CalendarYear <> cy.y OR d.DateKey <= cy.max_date)
    GROUP BY year, quarter_num
),
sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.CalendarYear AS year,
        toQuarter(d.DateKey) AS quarter_num,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    CROSS JOIN current_year AS cy
    WHERE (d.CalendarYear = cy.y OR d.CalendarYear = cy.y - 1)
      AND (d.CalendarYear <> cy.y OR d.DateKey <= cy.max_date)
    GROUP BY year, quarter_num
),
quarter_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.year AS year,
        s.quarter_num AS quarter_num,
        s.sales_amount / nullIf(dd.days_in_quarter, 0) AS avg_daily_sales
    FROM sales AS s
    INNER JOIN date_days AS dd
        ON s.year = dd.year AND s.quarter_num = dd.quarter_num
),
current_quarters AS (
    SELECT
        dd.year AS year,
        dd.quarter_num AS quarter_num,
        dd.quarter_label AS quarter_label
    FROM date_days AS dd
    CROSS JOIN current_year AS cy
    WHERE dd.year = cy.y
)
SELECT
    cq.quarter_label AS `季度`,
    round(coalesce(cur.avg_daily_sales, 0), 2) AS `今年日均销售额`,
    round(prev.avg_daily_sales, 2) AS `去年同期日均销售额`,
    round(coalesce(cur.avg_daily_sales, 0) - prev.avg_daily_sales, 2) AS `同比日均销售额变化`,
    round(
        (coalesce(cur.avg_daily_sales, 0) - prev.avg_daily_sales)
        / nullIf(prev.avg_daily_sales, 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS `同比增长率(%)`
FROM current_quarters AS cq
LEFT JOIN quarter_stats AS cur
    ON cq.year = cur.year AND cq.quarter_num = cur.quarter_num
LEFT JOIN quarter_stats AS prev
    ON cq.quarter_num = prev.quarter_num
   AND prev.year = (SELECT y - 1 FROM current_year)
ORDER BY cq.quarter_num
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1;

        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactSales f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY DayType
)
SELECT
    DayType,
    SalesAmount,
    round(SalesAmount / nullIf(sum(SalesAmount) OVER (), 0) * 100, 2) AS RatioPct,
    sum(SalesAmount) OVER () AS TotalSalesAmount
FROM sales
ORDER BY DayType = '周末'
turns.assumption: 周末按 DimDate.CalendarDayOfWeekNumber 为 1（周日）或 7（周六）判定；销售取 retail.FactSales 的 SalesAmount 全渠道汇总。

turns.query:
WITH order_sales AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        SalesOrderNumber,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS order_sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY
        CustomerKey,
        SalesOrderNumber
)
SELECT
    c.Gender AS gender,
    round(avg(o.order_sales_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    count() AS order_count
FROM order_sales AS o
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
    ON o.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
GROUP BY c.Gender
ORDER BY c.Gender
turns.assumption: 客单价按每位客户每张在线销售订单的销售额均值计算，使用 SalesAmount 且不扣减退货金额。

turns.query:
SELECT
    p.PromotionType,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountAmount
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
    ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
GROUP BY p.PromotionType
ORDER BY TotalDiscountAmount DESC
turns.assumption: 促销类型按 `DimPromotion.PromotionType` 分组，且仅统计 `FactOnlineSales` 中的线上销售折扣金额。

turns.query:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        multiIf(d.CalendarDayOfWeekLabel IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday'), '周末', '工作日') AS day_type,
        f.SalesAmount AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        day_type,
        sum(sales_amount) AS sales_amount
    FROM base
    GROUP BY day_type
),
total AS (
    SELECT sum(sales_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM agg
)
SELECT
    a.day_type AS `日期类型`,
    a.sales_amount AS `销售额`,
    t.total_sales AS `总销售额`,
    round(a.sales_amount / nullIf(t.total_sales, 0) * 100, 2) AS `占比(%)`
FROM agg AS a
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY a.day_type;
turns.assumption: 以 retail.FactSales 的 SalesAmount 作为销售额，并按 DimDate.CalendarDayOfWeekLabel 的 Saturday/Sunday 判定周末。

turns.query:
SELECT
    c.Gender AS `性别`,
    round(sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullIf(uniqExact(f.SalesOrderNumber), 0), 2) AS `客单价`,

FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c

turns.query:

turns.query:

FROM
(
    SELECT fos.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    INNER JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate AS fer

       AND fos.DateKey = fer.DateKey

turns.query:

turns.query:
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    sum(f.OnHandQuantity) AS OnHandQuantity,
    sum(f.SafetyStockQuantity) AS SafetyStockQuantity,
    sum(f.SafetyStockQuantity) - sum(f.OnHandQuantity) AS ShortageQuantity
FROM retail.FactInventory AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE f.DateKey = (SELECT max(DateKey) FROM retail.FactInventory)
GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName
HAVING sum(f.OnHandQuantity) < sum(f.SafetyStockQuantity)
ORDER BY ShortageQuantity DESC, p.ProductName
turns.assumption: 将“目前”理解为 retail.FactInventory 中的最新日期，并将同一产品在所有门店的库存与安全库存分别汇总后比较。

turns.query:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT max(DateKey) AS d
    FROM retail.FactInventory
)
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) AS OnHandQuantity,
    sum(fi.SafetyStockQuantity) AS SafetyStockQuantity,
    sum(fi.SafetyStockQuantity) - sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) AS ShortageQuantity
FROM retail.FactInventory AS fi
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON fi.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE fi.DateKey = (SELECT d FROM latest)
GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName
HAVING sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) < sum(fi.SafetyStockQuantity)
ORDER BY ShortageQuantity DESC
turns.assumption: 将「目前」理解为库存表中最新的日期，并把同一产品在各门店的现有库存与安全库存分别汇总后比较。

turns.query:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    StoreKey,
    max(DateKey) AS LastDateKey
  FROM retail.FactInventory
  GROUP BY StoreKey
)
SELECT
  st.StoreName AS StoreName,
  st.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
  sum(inv.OnHandQuantity) AS OnHandQuantity
FROM retail.FactInventory AS inv
INNER JOIN latest AS l
  ON inv.StoreKey = l.StoreKey
 AND inv.DateKey = l.LastDateKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS st
  ON st.StoreKey = inv.StoreKey
GROUP BY
  st.StoreName,
  st.StoreKey
ORDER BY
  OnHandQuantity DESC,
  StoreName

turns.query:
WITH latest AS (

  FROM retail.FactInventory

)
SELECT

turns.query:
WITH latest_inventory_date AS (

turns.query:
WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        g.RegionCountryName AS Country,
        c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,
        concat(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS CustomerName,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SpendAmount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
        ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g
        ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    GROUP BY Country, CustomerKey, CustomerName
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Country,
        CustomerKey,
        CustomerName,
        SpendAmount,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY SpendAmount DESC) AS Ranking
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
    Country AS `国家`,
    Ranking AS `名次`,
    CustomerName AS `客户`,
    SpendAmount AS `累计消费额`
FROM ranked
WHERE Ranking <= 5
ORDER BY Country, Ranking;
turns.assumption: 累计消费额按 FactOnlineSales.SalesAmount 汇总，列出每个国家内消费额前 5 的客户，未扣减退货金额。

turns.query:
WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT max(DateKey) AS d
    FROM retail.FactInventory
)
SELECT
    p.ProductName AS product_name,
    s.StoreName AS store_name,
    i.OnHandQuantity AS on_hand_quantity,
    i.SafetyStockQuantity AS safety_stock_quantity,
    i.SafetyStockQuantity - i.OnHandQuantity AS shortage_quantity
FROM retail.FactInventory AS i
INNER JOIN latest_date AS l
    ON i.DateKey = l.d
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s
    ON i.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
WHERE i.OnHandQuantity < i.SafetyStockQuantity
ORDER BY p.ProductName, s.StoreName
turns.assumption: 「目前」指库存事实表中的最新日期，且库存是否低于安全库存按门店-产品粒度判断。

turns.query:
WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT
    g.RegionCountryName AS Country,
    c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,
    concat(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS CustomerName,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS CumulativeSalesAmount
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
  INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
    ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
  INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g
    ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
  GROUP BY
    g.RegionCountryName,
    c.CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Country,
    CustomerKey,
    CustomerName,
    CumulativeSalesAmount,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY Country
      ORDER BY CumulativeSalesAmount DESC, CustomerKey ASC
    ) AS Rank
  FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
  Country,
  Rank,
  CustomerKey,
  CustomerName,
  CumulativeSalesAmount
FROM ranked
WHERE Rank <= 5
ORDER BY Country, Rank
turns.assumption: 问题要求按国家分别取前 5 名客户，且累计消费额按 FactOnlineSales.SalesAmount 求和、不扣减退货并沿用原始币种。

turns.query:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS sales_quantity,
    sum(f.ReturnQuantity) AS return_quantity,
    round(sum(f.ReturnQuantity) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pc.ProductCategoryName;
turns.assumption: 退货率按退货数量 ÷ 销售数量计算，并基于零售销售事实表（retail.FactSales）统计。

turns.query:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
    sum(f.ReturnQuantity) AS return_quantity,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS sales_quantity,
    round(sum(f.ReturnQuantity) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = toFloat64(ps.ProductSubcategoryKey)
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY product_category;
turns.assumption: 使用零售全渠道销售事实表 FactSales，并将退货率定义为退货数量 ÷ 销售数量。

turns.query:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        d.CalendarMonthLabel AS month_label,
        d.MonthNumber AS month_number,
        sum(s.SalesAmount) AS monthly_sales
    FROM retail.DimDate d
    LEFT JOIN retail.FactSales s ON d.DateKey = s.DateKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
    GROUP BY d.CalendarMonthLabel, d.MonthNumber
)
SELECT
    month_label AS `月份`,
    sum(monthly_sales) OVER (
        ORDER BY month_number
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS `累计销售额`
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month_number;
turns.assumption: 使用 retail.FactSales 的 SalesAmount 汇总全部渠道销售额，且不扣减退货金额。

turns.query:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
    sum(f.ReturnQuantity) AS ReturnQuantity,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS SalesQuantity,
    round(sum(f.ReturnQuantity) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0) * 100, 2) AS ReturnRatePct
FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pc.ProductCategoryName
turns.assumption: 使用 retail.FactSales 作为全部销售口径，退货率按退货数量 ÷ 销售数量计算。

turns.query:
SELECT
    d.NorthAmericaSeason AS season,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) / count(DISTINCT f.DateKey) AS avg_daily_sales
FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g ON s.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
WHERE g.ContinentName = 'North America'
GROUP BY d.NorthAmericaSeason
ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
turns.assumption: 销售额取 FactSales.SalesAmount，北美按门店所在 DimGeography.ContinentName 判断，日均销售额按该季节有销售记录的日期数计算。

turns.query:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(DateKey) AS FirstPurchaseDate
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE SalesQuantity > 0
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
first_purchase_quarter AS (
    SELECT
        d.CalendarQuarterLabel AS QuarterLabel,
        count() AS Customers
    FROM first_purchase fp
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d
        ON fp.FirstPurchaseDate = d.DateKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2007
    GROUP BY d.CalendarQuarterLabel
),
quarters AS (
    SELECT
        CalendarQuarterLabel AS QuarterLabel,
        min(DateKey) AS QuarterStart
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE CalendarYear = 2007
    GROUP BY CalendarQuarterLabel
)
SELECT
    q.QuarterLabel,
    coalesce(f.Customers, 0) AS Customers
FROM quarters q
LEFT JOIN first_purchase_quarter f
    ON q.QuarterLabel = f.QuarterLabel
ORDER BY q.QuarterStart
turns.assumption: 将 retail.FactOnlineSales 中 SalesQuantity > 0 的最早 DateKey 视为客户首次购买日期，并按该日期所在季度统计 2007 年完成首次购买的客户数。

turns.query:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(DateKey) AS FirstPurchaseDate
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE CustomerKey > 0
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
first_purchase_2007 AS (
    SELECT
        dd.CalendarQuarterLabel AS Quarter,
        count() AS CustomerCount
    FROM first_purchase fp
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate dd
        ON dd.DateKey = fp.FirstPurchaseDate
    WHERE dd.CalendarYear = 2007
    GROUP BY dd.CalendarQuarterLabel
)
SELECT
    d.CalendarQuarterLabel AS Quarter,
    coalesce(f.CustomerCount, 0) AS CustomerCount
FROM (
    SELECT
        CalendarQuarterLabel,
        min(DateKey) AS QuarterStart
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE CalendarYear = 2007
    GROUP BY CalendarQuarterLabel
) d
LEFT JOIN first_purchase_2007 f
    ON f.Quarter = d.CalendarQuarterLabel
ORDER BY d.QuarterStart
turns.assumption: 首次购买以 FactOnlineSales 中每个客户最早的 DateKey 判定，并排除 CustomerKey ≤ 0 的未知客户。

turns.query:
WITH first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(DateKey) AS FirstPurchaseDate
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE CustomerKey != 0
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
first_2007 AS (
    SELECT
        toStartOfQuarter(FirstPurchaseDate) AS QuarterStart,
        count() AS CustomerCount
    FROM first_purchase
    WHERE FirstPurchaseDate >= toDate('2007-01-01')
      AND FirstPurchaseDate < toDate('2008-01-01')
    GROUP BY QuarterStart
),
quarters_2007 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        toStartOfQuarter(DateKey) AS QuarterStart,
        CalendarQuarterLabel
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2007-01-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2008-01-01')
)
SELECT
    q.CalendarQuarterLabel AS `季度`,
    coalesce(f.CustomerCount, 0) AS `首次购买客户数`
FROM quarters_2007 q
LEFT JOIN first_2007 f ON q.QuarterStart = f.QuarterStart
ORDER BY q.QuarterStart
turns.assumption: 以 retail.FactOnlineSales 中每个客户最早出现的购买日期作为首次购买日期，并排除 CustomerKey 为 0 的记录。

turns.query:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS month_start,
        CalendarMonthLabel AS month_label
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE CalendarYear = 2009
),
sales AS (
    SELECT
        toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS month_start,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    GROUP BY toStartOfMonth(DateKey)
)
SELECT
    m.month_label,
    sum(coalesce(s.sales_amount, 0)) OVER (
        ORDER BY m.month_start
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_sales_amount
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.month_start = s.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start
turns.assumption: 问题未指明销售渠道，因此使用零售销售事实表 `retail.FactSales` 的 `SalesAmount`，并按自然月计算 2009 年累计销售额。

turns.query:
WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        d.DateKey AS sale_date,
        d.NorthAmericaSeason AS season,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS daily_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g ON s.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    WHERE g.ContinentName = 'North America'
    GROUP BY d.DateKey, d.NorthAmericaSeason
)
SELECT
    season,
    avg(daily_sales) AS avg_daily_sales
FROM daily
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY avg_daily_sales DESC, season
LIMIT 1;
turns.assumption: 销售额按 retail.FactSales.SalesAmount 统计、北美按门店所在 DimGeography.ContinentName = 'North America' 识别，且日均按有销售记录的日期计算。

turns.query:
WITH product_margin AS (
    SELECT
        p.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        p.ProductName AS ProductName,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount,
        sum(f.TotalCost) AS TotalCost,
        (sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) * 100 AS MarginPct
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName
    HAVING sum(f.SalesAmount) > 0
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY MarginPct DESC, SalesAmount DESC) AS `名次`,
    ProductKey AS `产品编码`,
    if(ProductName = '', toString(ProductKey), ProductName) AS `产品名称`,
    SalesAmount AS `销售额`,
    MarginPct AS `利润率百分比`
FROM product_margin
ORDER BY MarginPct DESC, SalesAmount DESC
LIMIT 10
turns.assumption: 利润率按 retail.FactOnlineSales 汇总销售额与总成本计算，即（销售额合计 − 总成本合计）÷ 销售额合计，并按产品名称展示。

turns.query:
WITH product_margin AS (
    SELECT
        f.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        p.ProductName AS ProductName,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount,
        sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS ProfitAmount,
        sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) * 100 AS ProfitMarginPct
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    GROUP BY f.ProductKey, p.ProductName
    HAVING sum(f.SalesAmount) > 0
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ProfitMarginPct DESC, SalesAmount DESC) AS `名次`,
    ProductKey AS `产品编码`,
    ProductName AS `产品名称`,
    SalesAmount AS `销售额`,
    ProfitAmount AS `利润额`,
    round(ProfitMarginPct, 2) AS `利润率百分比`
FROM product_margin
ORDER BY ProfitMarginPct DESC, SalesAmount DESC
LIMIT 10;
turns.assumption: 利润率按（销售额 − 总成本）÷ 销售额计算，并基于 retail.FactSales 的全部销售记录。

turns.query:
WITH product_margin AS
(
    SELECT
        p.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        if(p.ProductName = '', toString(p.ProductKey), p.ProductName) AS ProductName,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount,
        sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS ProfitAmount,
        sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) AS ProfitMargin
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName
    HAVING sum(f.SalesAmount) > 0
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ProfitMargin DESC, ProductName ASC) AS `名次`,
    ProductName AS `产品名称`,
    round(ProfitMargin * 100, 2) AS `利润率(%)`,
    ProfitAmount AS `利润额`,

WITH
product_dates AS (
    SELECT
        p.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        toInt32(assumeNotNull(p.ProductSubcategoryKey)) AS SubcategoryKey,
        s.ProductSubcategoryName AS SubcategoryName,
        toDate(parseDateTimeBestEffort(assumeNotNull(p.AvailableForSaleDate))) AS LaunchDate
    FROM retail.DimProduct p
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory s
        ON toInt32(assumeNotNull(p.ProductSubcategoryKey)) = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    WHERE p.AvailableForSaleDate IS NOT NULL
      AND p.AvailableForSaleDate != ''
      AND p.ProductSubcategoryKey IS NOT NULL
),
first_launch AS (
    SELECT
        SubcategoryKey,
        SubcategoryName,
        min(LaunchDate) AS FirstLaunchDate
    FROM product_dates
    GROUP BY SubcategoryKey, SubcategoryName
),
event AS (
    SELECT
        pd.SubcategoryKey AS SubcategoryKey,
        pd.SubcategoryName AS SubcategoryName,
        min(pd.LaunchDate) AS EventDate
    FROM product_dates pd
    INNER JOIN first_launch fl
        ON pd.SubcategoryKey = fl.SubcategoryKey
    WHERE pd.LaunchDate > fl.FirstLaunchDate
    GROUP BY pd.SubcategoryKey, pd.SubcategoryName
),
sales_range AS (
    SELECT
        min(DateKey) AS MinDate,
        max(DateKey) AS MaxDate
    FROM retail.FactSales
),
old_sales AS (
    SELECT
        e.SubcategoryKey AS SubcategoryKey,
        e.SubcategoryName AS SubcategoryName,
        e.EventDate AS EventDate,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.DateKey >= addMonths(e.EventDate, -6) AND f.DateKey < e.EventDate) AS PreSales,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.DateKey >= e.EventDate AND f.DateKey < addMonths(e.EventDate, 6)) AS PostSales
    FROM event e
    INNER JOIN product_dates pd
        ON e.SubcategoryKey = pd.SubcategoryKey
       AND pd.LaunchDate < e.EventDate
    INNER JOIN retail.FactSales f
        ON pd.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
    CROSS JOIN sales_range sr
    WHERE e.EventDate >= addMonths(sr.MinDate, 6)
      AND e.EventDate <= addMonths(sr.MaxDate, -6)
    GROUP BY e.SubcategoryKey, e.SubcategoryName, e.EventDate
)

    SubcategoryName,
    EventDate,
    PreSales,
    PostSales,

    round((PostSales - PreSales) / PreSales * 100, 2) AS ChangeRatePct
FROM old_sales
WHERE PreSales > 0
ORDER BY ChangeRatePct ASC;

FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g ON s.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
GROUP BY g.RegionCountryName

SELECT
  pc.ProductCategoryName AS `品类`,
  sum(f.SalesAmount) AS `销售额`,
  sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS `销量`,
  sum(f.ReturnQuantity) AS `退货量`,
  sum(f.ReturnAmount) AS `退货金额`,
  sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS `折扣金额`,
  sum(f.TotalCost) AS `总成本`,
  sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) AS `毛利`,
  round(sum(f.SalesAmount - f.TotalCost) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) * 100, 2) AS `毛利率(%)`,
  round(sum(f.ReturnQuantity) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesQuantity), 0) * 100, 2) AS `退货率(%)`
FROM retail.FactSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE lower(pc.ProductCategoryName) LIKE '%camera%'
   OR pc.ProductCategoryName LIKE '%相机%'
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
turns.assumption: 以 retail.FactSales 作为全渠道销售事实表，相机品类按产品大类名称包含 camera/相机 识别，毛利按销售额减总成本计算，退货和折扣单独列示。

WITH eur_rate AS (
    SELECT
        fx.DateKey,
        fx.EndOfDayRate AS eur_end_of_day_rate
    FROM retail.FactExchangeRate AS fx
    INNER JOIN retail.DimCurrency AS c
        ON fx.CurrencyKey = c.CurrencyKey
    WHERE c.CurrencyName = 'Euro'
)
SELECT
    sum(f.SalesAmount * er.eur_end_of_day_rate / nullIf(fx.EndOfDayRate, 0)) AS OnlineSalesAmountEUR
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate AS fx
    ON f.CurrencyKey = fx.CurrencyKey
   AND f.DateKey = fx.DateKey
INNER JOIN eur_rate AS er
    ON f.DateKey = er.DateKey
turns.assumption: FactExchangeRate.EndOfDayRate 是以共同基准货币表示的汇率，查询用同日欧元收盘汇率作为目标汇率折算；未匹配到汇率的销售行不计入。

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    d.CalendarYear AS year,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
  INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
  GROUP BY d.CalendarYear
)
SELECT
  year,
  sales_amount,
  sales_amount - lagInFrame(sales_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS yoy_change,
  round(
    (sales_amount - lagInFrame(sales_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))
    / nullIf(lagInFrame(sales_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS yoy_change_pct
FROM yearly
ORDER BY year
turns.assumption: 用线上销售事实表 retail.FactOnlineSales 代表线上销售，按自然年汇总销售额并计算同比变化。

    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p

    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps

    ProductKey AS `产品编码`,
    ProductName AS `产品名称`,
    OnHandQuantity AS `当前库存`,
    SafetyStockQuantity AS `安全库存`,
    InventoryDifference AS `库存差额`
FROM product_inventory
ORDER BY InventoryDifference DESC, ProductKey
LIMIT 10;

WITH latest_date AS (
    SELECT max(DateKey) AS max_dt
    FROM retail.FactInventory
),
product_gap AS (
    SELECT
        fi.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        p.ProductName AS ProductName,
        sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) AS OnHandQty,
        sum(fi.SafetyStockQuantity) AS SafetyQty,
        sum(fi.OnHandQuantity) - sum(fi.SafetyStockQuantity) AS GapQty
    FROM retail.FactInventory AS fi
    INNER JOIN latest_date AS ld
        ON fi.DateKey = ld.max_dt
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fi.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    GROUP BY fi.ProductKey, p.ProductName
)
SELECT
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY GapQty DESC) AS `名次`,
    ProductKey AS `产品编码`,
    if(ProductName = '', toString(ProductKey), ProductName) AS `产品名称`,
    OnHandQty AS `当前库存`,
    SafetyQty AS `安全库存`,
    GapQty AS `差额`
FROM product_gap
ORDER BY GapQty DESC
LIMIT 10
turns.assumption: “当前库存”取 retail.FactInventory 全表最新 DateKey 的快照，并按产品汇总所有门店；差额按当前库存减安全库存计算。

FROM quarters q

ORDER BY q.year, q.quarter_num

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008) AS amount_2008,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009) AS amount_2009
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT
    c.CustomerKey,
    concat(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS customer_name,
    y.amount_2008,
    y.amount_2009,
    y.amount_2009 - y.amount_2008 AS growth_amount,
    round((y.amount_2009 - y.amount_2008) / y.amount_2008 * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM yearly AS y
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
    ON c.CustomerKey = y.CustomerKey
WHERE y.amount_2008 > 0
  AND y.amount_2009 > y.amount_2008 * 1.5
ORDER BY growth_rate_pct DESC, customer_name

WITH customer_sales AS (

        f.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2008) AS SalesAmount2008,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2009) AS SalesAmount2009
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)

    concat(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS CustomerName,
    cs.SalesAmount2008 AS SalesAmount2008,
    cs.SalesAmount2009 AS SalesAmount2009,
    cs.SalesAmount2009 - cs.SalesAmount2008 AS IncreaseAmount,
    round((cs.SalesAmount2009 - cs.SalesAmount2008) / cs.SalesAmount2008 * 100, 2) AS GrowthRatePercent
FROM customer_sales AS cs
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c ON cs.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE cs.SalesAmount2009 >= cs.SalesAmount2008 * 1.5
ORDER BY GrowthRatePercent DESC, CustomerKey

WITH repeat_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) >= 2
)
SELECT
    if(empty(pc.ProductCategoryName), toString(pc.ProductCategoryKey), pc.ProductCategoryName) AS product_category_name,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS total_online_sales_amount,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, rc.CustomerKey IS NOT NULL) AS repeat_customer_sales_amount,
    round(
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, rc.CustomerKey IS NOT NULL) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS repeat_customer_sales_ratio_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
LEFT JOIN repeat_customers AS rc
    ON f.CustomerKey = rc.CustomerKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pc.ProductCategoryKey
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
turns.assumption: 回头客按其在线上销售事实表中的去重订单号数量至少 2 笔判定，销售额使用 SalesAmount 且未扣减退货。

WITH returning_customers AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        1 AS is_returning
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) >= 2
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS category_name,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS total_sales_amount,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, rc.is_returning = 1) AS returning_sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN returning_customers AS rc
        ON f.CustomerKey = rc.CustomerKey
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    category_name AS `产品品类`,
    total_sales_amount AS `线上销售额`,
    returning_sales_amount AS `回头客销售额`,
    round(100 * returning_sales_amount / nullIf(total_sales_amount, 0), 2) AS `回头客销售额占比(%)`
FROM category_sales
ORDER BY category_name;
turns.assumption: 回头客按全部线上销售历史中拥有至少 2 个不同 SalesOrderNumber 的客户判定，并将其在所有品类的线上销售额都计入回头客销售额。

WITH
  months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS month_start,
      CalendarYear AS calendar_year,
      MonthNumber AS month_number,
      CalendarMonthLabel AS month_label
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2008-12-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
  ),
  sales AS (
    SELECT
      toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS month_start,
      sum(SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2008-12-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    GROUP BY month_start
  ),
  monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
      m.month_start,
      m.calendar_year,
      m.month_number,
      m.month_label,
      coalesce(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount
    FROM months AS m
    LEFT JOIN sales AS s ON m.month_start = s.month_start
  ),
  with_prev AS (
    SELECT
      month_start,
      calendar_year,
      month_number,
      month_label,
      sales_amount,
      lagInFrame(sales_amount) OVER (
        ORDER BY month_start
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
      ) AS prev_sales_amount
    FROM monthly_sales
  )
SELECT
  toString(month_start) AS month,
  month_label,
  sales_amount,
  prev_sales_amount,
  round(
    (sales_amount - prev_sales_amount) / nullIf(prev_sales_amount, 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM with_prev
WHERE calendar_year = 2009
ORDER BY month_start
turns.assumption: 线上销售额取 retail.FactOnlineSales.SalesAmount 的自然月汇总，且 2009 年 1 月的环比基期为 2008 年 12 月。

turns.query:
WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        fs.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
        ds.StoreName AS StoreName,
        fs.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        dp.ProductName AS ProductName,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS ProductSales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS ds
        ON fs.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS dp
        ON fs.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
    WHERE fs.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
      AND fs.DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    GROUP BY
        fs.StoreKey,
        ds.StoreName,
        fs.ProductKey,
        dp.ProductName
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        StoreName,
        ProductKey,
        ProductName,
        ProductSales,
        sum(ProductSales) OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey) AS StoreTotalSales,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY StoreKey
            ORDER BY ProductSales DESC, ProductKey
        ) AS RankNo
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
    StoreName,
    ProductName,
    ProductSales,
    StoreTotalSales,
    round(ProductSales / StoreTotalSales * 100, 2) AS SharePercent,
    RankNo
FROM ranked
WHERE RankNo <= 3
ORDER BY StoreName, RankNo
turns.assumption: 以 retail.FactSales 的 SalesAmount 作为销售额、门店销售总额为 2009 年该门店全部产品销售额合计，并列时按 ProductKey 排序取前 3。

WITH months AS (

    CalendarYear AS year,
    MonthNumber AS month_number,
    any(CalendarMonthLabel) AS month_label
  FROM retail.DimDate
  WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2008-12-01')
    AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
  GROUP BY CalendarYear, MonthNumber
),
sales AS (
  SELECT
    d.CalendarYear AS year,
    d.MonthNumber AS month_number,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
  WHERE d.DateKey >= toDate('2008-12-01')
    AND d.DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
  GROUP BY d.CalendarYear, d.MonthNumber
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    m.year,
    m.month_number,
    m.month_label,
    coalesce(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN sales s
    ON m.year = s.year
   AND m.month_number = s.month_number
)
SELECT
  m.month_label AS `月份`,
  m.sales_amount AS `本期销售额`,
  p.sales_amount AS `基期销售额`,
  round((m.sales_amount - p.sales_amount) / nullIf(p.sales_amount, 0) * 100, 2) AS `环比增长率(%)`
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p
  ON p.year = if(m.month_number = 1, m.year - 1, m.year)
 AND p.month_number = if(m.month_number = 1, 12, m.month_number - 1)
WHERE m.year = 2009
ORDER BY m.month_number;

WITH category_discount AS (
    SELECT
        ifNull(p.PromotionCategory, '') AS PromotionCategory,
        sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS DiscountAmount
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p
        ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY ifNull(p.PromotionCategory, '')
),
total_discount AS (
    SELECT sum(DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountAmount
    FROM category_discount
)
SELECT
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY c.DiscountAmount DESC) AS RankNo,
    c.PromotionCategory AS PromotionCategory,
    c.DiscountAmount AS DiscountAmount,
    t.TotalDiscountAmount AS TotalDiscountAmount,
    round(c.DiscountAmount / nullIf(t.TotalDiscountAmount, 0) * 100, 2) AS DiscountSharePercent
FROM category_discount AS c
CROSS JOIN total_discount AS t
ORDER BY c.DiscountAmount DESC

WITH monthly_sales AS (

        toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS month_start,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2008-12-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT
    d.CalendarMonthLabel AS `月份`,

ORDER BY m.month_start
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1;

),

WITH rev AS (

        ProductKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS Revenue
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009

cum AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        Revenue,
        sum(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY Revenue DESC, ProductKey ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - Revenue AS RevenueBefore,
        sum(Revenue) OVER () AS TotalRevenue
    FROM rev
),
cls AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        Revenue,
        multiIf(RevenueBefore < TotalRevenue * 0.8, 'A',
                RevenueBefore < TotalRevenue * 0.95, 'B',
                'C') AS ABCClass
    FROM cum
)
SELECT
    ABCClass,
    count() AS ProductCount,
    sum(Revenue) AS Revenue
FROM cls
GROUP BY ABCClass
ORDER BY ABCClass

WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        f.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS revenue
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY f.ProductKey
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        revenue,
        sum(revenue) OVER () AS total_revenue,
        sum(revenue) OVER (
            ORDER BY revenue DESC, ProductKey
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_revenue
    FROM product_revenue
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        multiIf(
            cumulative_revenue - revenue < total_revenue * 0.80, 'A',
            cumulative_revenue - revenue < total_revenue * 0.95, 'B',
            'C'
        ) AS abc_class
    FROM ranked
)

    abc_class,
    count() AS product_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY abc_class
ORDER BY abc_class;

WITH actual_sales AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_amount
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
target_sales AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS target_amount
    FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
      AND SalesAmountQuota IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
store_rate AS (
    SELECT
        s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
        s.StoreName AS StoreName,
        coalesce(a.actual_amount, 0) AS actual_amount,
        t.target_amount AS target_amount,
        coalesce(a.actual_amount, 0) / nullIf(t.target_amount, 0) AS achievement_rate
    FROM target_sales t
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore s ON t.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
    LEFT JOIN actual_sales a ON t.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
    WHERE t.target_amount > 0
),
high_rank AS (
    SELECT
        '最高' AS `类别`,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_rate DESC, StoreKey) AS `排名`,
        StoreKey AS `门店编码`,
        StoreName AS `门店名称`,
        actual_amount AS `实际销售额`,
        target_amount AS `销售目标`,
        round(achievement_rate * 100, 2) AS `达成率百分比`
    FROM store_rate
),
low_rank AS (
    SELECT
        '最低' AS `类别`,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_rate ASC, StoreKey) AS `排名`,
        StoreKey AS `门店编码`,
        StoreName AS `门店名称`,
        actual_amount AS `实际销售额`,
        target_amount AS `销售目标`,
        round(achievement_rate * 100, 2) AS `达成率百分比`
    FROM store_rate
)
SELECT * FROM high_rank WHERE `排名` <= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM low_rank WHERE `排名` <= 5
ORDER BY CASE WHEN `类别` = '最高' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, `排名`;
turns.assumption: 将 FactSalesQuota 中 2009 年所有 ScenarioKey 的 SalesAmountQuota 合计视为门店销售目标，实际销售额按 FactSales.SalesAmount 汇总且不扣减退货；仅计算目标额大于 0 的门店。

WITH
actual AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
quota AS (
    SELECT
        q.StoreKey,
        sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) AS sales_quota
    FROM retail.FactSalesQuota AS q
    INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario AS sc
        ON q.ScenarioKey = sc.ScenarioKey
    WHERE toYear(q.DateKey) = 2009
      AND sc.ScenarioName = 'Budget'
    GROUP BY q.StoreKey
),
achievement AS (
    SELECT
        q.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
        st.StoreName AS StoreName,
        coalesce(a.actual_sales, 0) AS actual_sales,
        q.sales_quota AS sales_quota,
        coalesce(a.actual_sales, 0) / q.sales_quota AS achievement_rate
    FROM quota AS q
    LEFT JOIN actual AS a ON q.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS st ON q.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
    WHERE q.sales_quota > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_rate DESC, actual_sales DESC, StoreKey) AS rn_high,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_rate ASC, actual_sales ASC, StoreKey) AS rn_low
    FROM achievement
)
SELECT
    '最高' AS `分组`,
    rn_high AS `名次`,
    StoreName AS `门店名称`,
    StoreKey AS `门店编码`,
    actual_sales AS `实际销售额`,
    sales_quota AS `销售目标`,
    round(achievement_rate * 100, 2) AS `目标达成率(%)`
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_high <= 5
UNION ALL
SELECT
    '最低' AS `分组`,
    rn_low AS `名次`,
    StoreName AS `门店名称`,
    StoreKey AS `门店编码`,
    actual_sales AS `实际销售额`,
    sales_quota AS `销售目标`,
    round(achievement_rate * 100, 2) AS `目标达成率(%)`
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_low <= 5
ORDER BY if(`分组` = '最高', 0, 1), `名次`

WITH category_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryKey AS ProductCategoryKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,

        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS QuarterSales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY

        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        d.CalendarYear,
        d.CalendarQuarterLabel
),
category_year_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        CalendarYear,
        sum(QuarterSales) AS AnnualSales
    FROM category_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        CalendarYear
),
category_quarter_share AS (
    SELECT
        q.ProductCategoryKey,
        q.ProductCategoryName,
        q.CalendarYear,
        q.CalendarQuarterLabel,
        q.QuarterSales,
        y.AnnualSales,
        q.QuarterSales / nullIf(y.AnnualSales, 0) AS QuarterShare
    FROM category_quarter_sales AS q
    INNER JOIN category_year_sales AS y
        ON q.ProductCategoryKey = y.ProductCategoryKey
       AND q.CalendarYear = y.CalendarYear
),
category_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        argMax(CalendarYear, QuarterShare) AS MaxQuarterYear,
        argMax(CalendarQuarterLabel, QuarterShare) AS MaxQuarterLabel,
        argMax(QuarterSales, QuarterShare) AS MaxQuarterSales,
        argMax(AnnualSales, QuarterShare) AS AnnualSales,
        round(max(QuarterShare) * 100, 2) AS QuarterDependencyPercent
    FROM category_quarter_share
    GROUP BY
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY QuarterDependencyPercent DESC, ProductCategoryName) AS Rank,
    ProductCategoryKey,
    ProductCategoryName,
    MaxQuarterYear,
    MaxQuarterLabel,
    MaxQuarterSales,
    AnnualSales,
    QuarterDependencyPercent
FROM category_summary
ORDER BY Rank;

WITH category_quarter_sales AS (

        pc.ProductCategoryKey AS ProductCategoryKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
        dd.CalendarQuarterLabel AS quarter_label,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS quarter_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS dd
        ON f.DateKey = dd.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        dd.CalendarQuarterLabel
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryKey,
        ProductCategoryName,
        sum(quarter_sales) AS total_sales
    FROM category_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY ProductCategoryKey, ProductCategoryName
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cqs.ProductCategoryKey,
        cqs.ProductCategoryName,
        cqs.quarter_label,
        cqs.quarter_sales,
        ct.total_sales,
        cqs.quarter_sales / nullIf(ct.total_sales, 0) AS dependency_ratio,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cqs.ProductCategoryKey
            ORDER BY cqs.quarter_sales DESC, cqs.quarter_label
        ) AS rn
    FROM category_quarter_sales AS cqs
    INNER JOIN category_totals AS ct
        ON cqs.ProductCategoryKey = ct.ProductCategoryKey
)
SELECT
    dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY dependency_ratio DESC) AS rank_no,
    ProductCategoryKey,
    ProductCategoryName,
    quarter_label AS top_quarter,
    quarter_sales AS top_quarter_sales,
    total_sales AS annual_sales,
    round(dependency_ratio * 100, 2) AS dependency_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY dependency_ratio DESC, ProductCategoryName;

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName,
        f.DateKey AS DateKey,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS DailySalesAmount,
        max(if(d.CalendarDayOfWeekLabel IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday'), 1, 0)) AS IsWeekend,
        max(if(d.IsWorkDay = 'Yes', 1, 0)) AS IsWorkday
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        f.DateKey
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWeekend = 1) AS AvgWeekendDailySales,
    avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWorkday = 1) AS AvgWorkdayDailySales,
    avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWeekend = 1) - avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWorkday = 1) AS DifferenceAmount,
    (avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWeekend = 1) - avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWorkday = 1))
        / nullIf(avgIf(DailySalesAmount, IsWorkday = 1), 0) * 100 AS DifferencePercent
FROM daily
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
HAVING countIf(IsWeekend = 1) > 0
   AND countIf(IsWorkday = 1) > 0
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName
turns.assumption: 使用 FactSales 的 SalesAmount，周末日按 CalendarDayOfWeekLabel 为 Saturday/Sunday 判定，工作日按 IsWorkDay='Yes' 判定，其他日期不参与比较，且日均仅基于有销售的日期计算。

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT min(DateKey) AS min_d, max(DateKey) AS max_d
    FROM retail.FactSales
),
day_counts AS (
    SELECT
        countIf(toDayOfWeek(DateKey) IN (6, 7)) AS weekend_days,
        countIf(toDayOfWeek(DateKey) NOT IN (6, 7)) AS workday_days
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE DateKey BETWEEN (SELECT min_d FROM bounds) AND (SELECT max_d FROM bounds)
),
cat_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryKey,
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toDayOfWeek(f.DateKey) IN (6, 7)) AS weekend_sales,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toDayOfWeek(f.DateKey) NOT IN (6, 7)) AS workday_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = toFloat64(ps.ProductSubcategoryKey)
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    c.ProductCategoryName AS `产品品类`,
    round(c.weekend_sales / nullIf(dc.weekend_days, 0), 2) AS `平均周末日销售额`,
    round(c.workday_sales / nullIf(dc.workday_days, 0), 2) AS `平均工作日销售额`,
    round(
        c.weekend_sales / nullIf(dc.weekend_days, 0)
        - c.workday_sales / nullIf(dc.workday_days, 0),
        2
    ) AS `高出金额`,
    round(
        (
            c.weekend_sales / nullIf(dc.weekend_days, 0)
            - c.workday_sales / nullIf(dc.workday_days, 0)
        ) / nullIf(c.workday_sales / nullIf(dc.workday_days, 0), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS `高出百分比`
FROM cat_sales AS c
CROSS JOIN day_counts AS dc
ORDER BY c.ProductCategoryName

WITH
sales_daily AS (
    SELECT
        if(
            ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = 0 OR ps.ProductCategoryKey = 0 OR pc.ProductCategoryName = '',
            '未分类',
            pc.ProductCategoryName
        ) AS category,
        f.DateKey AS date,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32OrNull(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY category, date
),
dates AS (
    SELECT
        DateKey,
        multiIf(
            lower(CalendarDayOfWeekLabel) IN ('saturday', 'sunday', '星期六', '星期日', '周日', '周六'), 'weekend',
            lower(IsWorkDay) IN ('true', '1', 'y', 'yes', '是'), 'workday',
            'other'
        ) AS day_type
    FROM retail.DimDate
    WHERE DateKey BETWEEN (SELECT min(DateKey) FROM retail.FactSales)
                      AND (SELECT max(DateKey) FROM retail.FactSales)
),
categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT category
    FROM sales_daily
),
grid AS (
    SELECT
        c.category,
        d.day_type,
        coalesce(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount
    FROM categories AS c
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT DateKey, day_type
        FROM dates
        WHERE day_type IN ('weekend', 'workday')
    ) AS d
    LEFT JOIN sales_daily AS s
        ON s.category = c.category AND s.date = d.DateKey
)
SELECT
    category,
    avg_workday_sales,
    avg_weekend_sales,
    diff_amount,
    diff_pct,
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY diff_amount DESC) AS rank_no
FROM (
    SELECT
        category,
        avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'workday') AS avg_workday_sales,
        avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'weekend') AS avg_weekend_sales,
        avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'weekend') - avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'workday') AS diff_amount,
        if(
            avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'workday') = 0,
            NULL,
            (avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'weekend') - avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'workday'))
            / avgIf(sales_amount, day_type = 'workday') * 100
        ) AS diff_pct
    FROM grid
    GROUP BY category
) AS t
ORDER BY diff_amount DESC

            sum(coalesce(q.SalesAmountQuota, 0)) AS target_sales
        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota AS q
        INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario AS s
            ON q.ScenarioKey = s.ScenarioKey
        WHERE toYear(q.DateKey) = 2009
          AND s.ScenarioName = 'Budget'
        GROUP BY q.StoreKey
    )
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY a.actual_sales / nullIf(t.target_sales, 0) DESC) AS `名次`,
    if(empty(d.StoreName), toString(t.StoreKey), d.StoreName) AS `门店`,
    a.actual_sales AS `实际销售额`,
    t.target_sales AS `销售目标额`,
    round(a.actual_sales / nullIf(t.target_sales, 0) * 100, 2) AS `销售目标达成率百分比`
FROM target AS t
LEFT JOIN actual AS a
    ON t.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimStore AS d
    ON t.StoreKey = d.StoreKey
WHERE t.target_sales > 0
ORDER BY `销售目标达成率百分比` DESC
LIMIT 10
